name: Incantations from the Nether
summary: Beneath Orgrimmar, Searing Blade cultists hold Incantations from the Nether, a grimoire of demonic magic. Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras seek its fel knowledge for the Forsaken.

sections.title: Gifts of the Legion
sections.body: The Searing Blade is a subterranean sect tied to the Shadow Council, working in the fiery tunnels of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar's red stone streets. Its cultists prize Incantations from the Nether, a spellbook of demonic rites given by agents of the Burning Legion. They use its secrets to plot treason in the Orcish capital. Word of the tome has reached the royal quarters of Undercity.

sections.title: Forsaken Ambition
sections.body: Varimathras sends loyal Horde adventurers deep into Ragefire Chasm to recover Incantations from the Nether and its sister volume, Spells of Shadow. Sylvanas Windrunner and her dreadlord lieutenant see such fel relics as wasted on cultists with lesser vision. The Dark Lady means to wield the book's nether-forged power against the Lich King and bring retribution to the Scourge.

faq.q: Where is the book Incantations from the Nether found?
aliases: where to get incantations from the nether
who drops incantations from the nether
faq.answer: Searing Blade cultists and warlocks carry the book in Ragefire Chasm, the volcanic cavern network beneath Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Who wants this book and why?
aliases: who needs incantations from the nether
why does sylvanas want this book
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the dreadlord Varimathras seek the book. They consider the Searing Blade cultists petty, with lesser vision, and want its demonic magic to fight their sworn enemy, the Lich King.

The Searing Blade is a secretive subterranean sect of warlocks and cultists beneath Orgrimmar, allied with the Shadow Council. Its members serve the Burning Legion and work in secret to undermine Thrall's new Horde.

faq.q: What other book is paired with this one?
faq.answer: Varimathras requires two volumes: Incantations from the Nether and Spells of Shadow. Both must be taken from the cultists in Ragefire Chasm to complete his mission.

angles.text: Recovering the book aids the Dark Lady's inner circle in Undercity. The dark knowledge is needed to wage war against the Scourge.
Tomes drawn directly from the Nether hold potent fel magic, coveted by ambitious practitioners of the dark arts.
